I replied in your DM thread. Moss's notes mention two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell logged it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting SMS bay assignments. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed the fix on 5 Oct.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because gatehouse scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was sent up to tier-2 support to test the scanner firmware.

That note has no date, so check that #4419 is still current before it goes into the weekly notes.

I went through all six of Moss's notes. Two others mention Quarrendon but give no ticket number: the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in. Moss's Central handoffs note lists #4409, #4412 and FR-882, but those are for a Central account, not Quarrendon. Moss's North cheat sheet also warns not to confuse Quarrendon Freight Lines with Quarendon Freightways (spelled with one "r"), which isn't a customer.
